  • Method Details

    • sendTokenByEmail

      public void sendTokenByEmail(EmailableToken token, String recipient) throws jakarta.mail.MessagingException
      Finalize initialization of the token and send it to the recipient.

      As the plain token is not stored in the database, the token is regenerated in this method.

      Parameters:
      token - the token to send
      recipient - recipient email address
      Throws:
      jakarta.mail.MessagingException - if sending the message fails

    • consume

      public Token consume(Long id, String plainToken)
      Consume the token
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the token to consume
      plainToken - the plain secret token as sent by e-mail
      Returns:
      the consumed token
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - notFound if the token does not exist;
      badRequest if token does not match;
      authenticationRequired if token requires authentication but current user is not

    • requestEmailAddressVerification

      public void requestEmailAddressVerification(LocalAccount account, boolean failsOnError)
      Send a "Please verify your email address" message.
      Parameters:
      account - account to verify
      failsOnError - if false, silent SMTP error
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - smtpError if there is an SMTP error AND failsOnError is set to true messageError if the message contains errors (e.g. malformed addresses)

      public InstanceMaker sendModelSharingToken(Project model, String recipient)
